evals.expected_output: The skill should REJECT the date format (ISO format yyyy-mm-dd is invalid). Should respond with: 'Formato de data inválido. Use dd/mm/yyyy (exemplo: 01/01/2024)'. Should ask the user to provide dates in dd/mm/yyyy format and offer to retry.
